libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Use JLine DumbTerminal with byte-array or piped input/output streams for deterministic, headless tests. Set a fixed terminal size, supply DefaultResourceLoader and TemplateExecutor where UI components require them, and ensure blocking UI loops receive explicit input or interruption. Avoid relying on the host TTY or TerminalBuilder provider discovery.
risks: Tests using the real system terminal may be platform-dependent or fail in headless/native execution.
Interactive component and TerminalUI loops can hang unless input and termination are controlled.
Native terminal-provider paths are optional and OS-specific; meaningful library coverage does not require exercising them.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: The artifact includes all required Spring Shell, JLine, Reactor, StringTemplate, and Spring dependencies transitively. Its components can be meaningfully exercised with an in-memory JLine terminal; no service, Docker image, or additional Maven dependency is required.
